# fael.tech

> Personal site of Rafael (Fael) Goulart, a Software Engineer, technology strategist, former CTO,
> and DPO working across front-end, full stack, AI Engineering, architecture, and security. It is
> also the home of the fael.tech brand visual identity. Static site, no build step, bilingual
> (pt-BR / en).

## Pages

- [Home (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/index.html): landing page - Software Engineer and technology
  strategist positioning, human-centered systems mission, areas of expertise, evidence, and a new professional chapter
  spanning products, consulting, engineering, leadership, and executive possibilities.
- [Home (en)](https://fael.tech/en/index.html): English version of the above.
- [Brand manual (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/manual.html): fael.tech visual identity - concept,
  symbol, lockups, colors, typography, liquid glass, downloadable assets.
- [Brand manual (en)](https://fael.tech/en/manual.html): English version of the above.
- [Career (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/sobre.html): professional profile, full experience timeline,
  technical and leadership outcomes, education, MIT certification, languages, and three lines of
  work for the new professional chapter.
- [Career (en)](https://fael.tech/en/sobre.html): English version of the above.
- [Contact (pt-BR)](https://fael.tech/contato.html): summary of the three lines of work, email,
  LinkedIn, GitHub, and location.
- [Contact (en)](https://fael.tech/en/contato.html): English version of the above.

## Docs for AI agents / LLMs

- [docs/ai/overview.md](./docs/ai/overview.md): purpose, structure, tone-of-voice guidance.
- [docs/ai/facts.md](./docs/ai/facts.md): canonical career/bio facts - single source of truth for
  numbers, dates, education, and certification.
- [docs/ai/content-map.md](./docs/ai/content-map.md): page-by-page purpose and key claims.

## Notes

- Career growth figures for Aurum are confirmed in [docs/ai/facts.md](./docs/ai/facts.md) and must
  stay aligned with the source texts in `career-library`.
- `brand/` is the single source of truth for brand visual assets (symbol SVGs,
  `tokens.css`, the original printable manual) - not a source for biographical facts.
